title: Dust storm coming!
prompt: A dust storm will block sunlight for a few days. Where should the power go first?

options.label: Protect the crew
options.cost: The greenhouse gets less power, so crops shrink.
options.why: In this game, shields only work when they have power. Plants also need power to grow, so food runs low later.

options.label: Protect the crops
options.why: In this game, a working greenhouse keeps food coming in, but a shield without power lets more radiation through.

options.label: Keep the science going
options.cost: Less radiation protection and a shrinking greenhouse.
options.why: In this game, research needs power too. Choosing it means other systems wait.
